rationale: CR-001 is resolved: useChatPromptResize now exposes userId, and the Group receives key={userId} so it remounts with the correct localStorage key when the real user ID resolves from userStore. The fix is minimal and targeted — userId is stable after initial auth, so no additional remounts occur during normal session use. No new high-risk issues introduced by the fix-up diff. All prior business_review and standards_review carry forward unchanged.
